title: Carl Pflock broke into a congressman's office and took Aztec evidence
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Carl Pflock broke into a congressman's office and took Aztec evidence, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He also said that that congressman's office was broken into by none other than Carl Flock.

plain: Aztec, New Mexico is the site of a claimed UFO crash said to have left alien bodies behind. Podcast host Jesse Michels passes on what a researcher of that case, Scott Ramsay, told him: that a congressman's office was broken into by Carl Pflock, another UFO researcher, and that evidence about Aztec was taken. If true, it would mean someone worked to make proof of the crash disappear.
